title: fix(plugin-grid): the built-in bulk delete reads the grid translation key
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb3UD8sKc65YtUfu8o3rLVg6)_
Fixes #28910

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：列表多选后，批量操作栏里内置的「删除」按钮和多选右键菜单里的同一项，现在按当前语言显示（中文为「删除」），不再固定显示英文 Delete。
- 为什么改：没有声明批量操作的对象会自动得到一个内置的删除操作，它的文字是从英文名格式化出来的，没读语言包里早已存在的翻译。
- 风险与回滚：只改按钮文字；操作集合、按钮位置和颜色都不变，自定义批量操作仍用自己的文字。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionBar.tsx` 的 `useBulkActionItems`（文字在这里解析一次），然后 `RowContextMenu.tsx` 的两行改动。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/BulkActionBar.deleteLabel.zh-28910.test.tsx`，预期 6 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `useBulkActionItems` (the one resolver the bulk bar and the selection's context menu both read) now resolves each string action's label once. `LegacyBulkActionItem` gains `label`: the string `delete` (case-insensitive) reads `grid.delete` from the active pack, and any other string name is still formatted from itself with `formatActionLabel`.
- `BulkActionBar` and `SelectionContextMenuItems` render that `label`, so the two entry points cannot disagree.
- The memo keys on the active `language` as well as on `t`, so the label follows a language switch without resting on the identity `t` keeps.
- Untouched: the default action set (`ObjectGrid` still hands the bar `delete`), the button's position and colour, and declared bulk defs, which keep `def.label`. `ui/packages/i18n` is read only: `grid.delete` is already present in all ten packs.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/BulkActionBar.deleteLabel.zh-28910.test.tsx` (6 tests): under zh the bar's button and the context-menu item read `zh.grid.delete` and not `en.grid.delete`; under en the button reads `en.grid.delete`; another string name (`mark_paid`) still reads "Mark Paid"; a declared def keeps its own label. Strings are read from the packs, never from literals.
- Ablation: with the label put back to `formatActionLabel(action)` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the two zh pins go red (2 failed, 4 passed) and the restore reads blob equal to HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Acceptance notes

- Under zh-CN the button reads 删除; under en it reads Delete. Pinned by the new test.
- A declared custom bulk action keeps its own label. Pinned by the new test.

## Verification

Readings are in the os-dev report on the card.
